#Blueface is making it clear that he’s not just showing up on the streaming scene — he’s making serious money from it. 💰👀

The rapper recently flexed that he pulled in a reported $136,000 in just one week, adding fuel to the conversation around artists making the transition from music into livestreaming and online entertainment. 

But the money wasn’t the only thing getting people talking. Blueface also addressed criticism that he uses women for content, pushing back hard against the narrative and claiming:

“I don’t use these b*tches for content, they got no clout for me.”

Is he wrong for that?
